svg.title: Hand Gesture PC Control
svg.desc: A webcam view of a hand skeleton controls a cursor on a screen. The hand moves the cursor, pinches thumb and index to click and drag a file into a folder, pinches thumb and ring finger to open the folder, then raises two fingers and moves up and down to scroll its contents.
svg.text: Your webcam sees your hand. Your computer follows it.
Move your hand and the cursor follows.
Pinch thumb and index to click or drag.
Pinch thumb and ring finger to open.
Raise two fingers, then move up or down to scroll.
